verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs say developers can "inspect and integrate code that actually matches design" using CSS, HTML, SVG and JSON, and that design is expressed as code. That covers the core inspect-and-code part of the story for web output. Nothing in the pack covers per-layer measurements, asset export from inspect, iOS/Android snippets, or inspect access without an editor seat. Missing for 10: per-layer measurement and asset-export evidence, iOS/Android code snippets, documented view-only/no-editor-seat inspect access, hands-on corroboration of inspect mode.
